description: FlowTrace provides operational tools for agents and people on NEAR. It reads native NEAR and three supported fungible-token balances at a final block, explains account access keys, compares two finalized account snapshots for net balance, permission and code-hash changes, investigates a declared payment against finalized FT receipts and optional 1Click status, and prepares unsigned FT-transfer templates after balance, storage and caller-limit checks. A web conversation can call the same tools; manual forms and JSON reports keep the inputs and evidence reviewable. It does not hold keys, sign transactions, enforce on-chain spending caps or claim to simulate contract execution.
